basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software engineer living on the East Coast of the US. I grew up playing video games, especially fighting games, and have recently picked up an interest in retro gaming. In my free time, I enjoy riding my Yamaha Bolt and diving into fantasy novels, with Artemis Fowl being a personal favorite. I work typical 9-5 hours, so I'm usually online in the evenings and weekends. Currently single, and focusing on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've got a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been coding since my teenage years. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and engaging with online communities. I have a knack for tech, which extends to understanding the nuances of retro gaming consoles.
